analysis: The test's app model, resource orchestration, and startup logic all succeeded (per the captured standard output); the failure occurs only during DistributedApplication.StopAsync teardown with a TaskCanceledException, matching a known pattern of intermittent host-shutdown timeouts under CI load. The PR under test only modifies Aspire.Dashboard console-log APIs and does not touch Aspire.Hosting.Azure.Tests, AzureFunctionsTests, or the DistributedApplication shutdown path, so the failure is unrelated to the PR changes.
